verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents an official `glitchtip-cli` with its own docs page. It supports login against a self-hosted instance, creating releases, recording deploys, uploading debug files, and injecting debug IDs and uploading source maps, which gives scriptable workflows an official command-line entry point. missing for 10: the CLI is labeled Beta, its documented scope covers only release and artifact management (no evidence of querying issues or events or of machine-readable output for agents), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
